sections.text: Introduction

This procedure details the
minor maintenance Procedure P1 of the circuit breaker should be carried out every 
six years as
indicated by Y6 in the above title block.

This is the inspection to keep the condition of the
breaker in order through detailed inspection and maintenance of the parts
outside of the gas space. The components in the SF6 gas compartments need not be
checked in this inspection . The items of the regular patrol inspection should
also be done during this inspection.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,

The circuit
breaker must be isolated completely and grounded on both sides,

Ensure that
the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the DS.

Safety fence
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Isolate the DC
voltage. (Switch off the control circuit and Insert closing and tripping
preventive pins.)

Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.

sections.text:
Environmental
Precautions

items:
Before using a
blower to clean the control cabinet or when cleaning the insulators, wear
breathing mask to protect your lung tissues from the dust particles.

Don't burn the
cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items:
Safety helmet,
shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.

Safety fence
(rope) with caution marks.

Tool set
of drivers, screw drivers, cloth

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
System of Circuit Breaker proper locate at Exterior

items:
Check the
tightness of anchor bolts.

Check the
tightness of ground terminal and other installation.

Check the abnormal
noise.

Check the rust
or damage of components.

sections.text: Gas System, Operating Mechanism Housing

1. 
Check the gas
pressure and temperature measurement within rated gas pressure.

2. Check
the setting of gas pressure gauge, refer to reference values
Air System, Operating Mechanism Housing

1. 
Check the air pressure.

2. Check
the setting of air pressure switches, refer to gas reference values

3. Check
air stop valves in position.

4. 
Drain the water from air reservoir
Operating Mechanism

1. 
Lubricate the mechanism, Pins where disassembled, refer to fig
8, 9 and PI-006

2. 
Visually, out side. Check the leakage of chock absorber oil.

3. 
Check the looseness of retainer ring and nuts

4. 
Replacement of some parts refer to item 11
Control System, Operating Mechanism Housing

1. 
Check disconnection of space heaters.

2. 
Check position of position indicator.

3. 
Check registered number of operation counters.

4. 
Check condensation and rust inside housing and water leak into
housing

5. 
Check the door packing, replace if aged.

6. 
Check the tightness of bolts in housing and terminals.
Operating Test (Check of function)
1. Manual opening and closing operation.

2. Check of air reservoir capacity, from rated pressure to
lockout pressure less than 150ms.

3. Check the closing time and opening time, please refer to
routine test report. Less than 20 ms.

sections.text: Replacement of the parts every 6 years (refer to Fig. 8)

It is recommended to replace the valve seat (3128) and valve
 seal (3318) of the pneumatic operating mechanism every 6 years. The circuit
 breaker should be out of service before coming this work.

Replacement procedure of the parts is as
follows:

items: Close the circuit breaker.
Switch off the control circuit.

Exhaust the compressed air in the
 air reservoir (3090) from the drain valve.

Insert the tripping preventing
 pin (3360) (refer to Fig .8(A)).

Remove the wiring of the trip
 coil assembly (3380).

Remove the pin (3132) (refer to
 Fig .9(a))

Remove the air piping (3353).
 (Refer to Fig .9(b)).

Remove the bolts A (3398) and
 bolts B(3399) .

Take out the control valve
 assembly (3300).
Replace the valve seat (3128).

Remove the nut (3326) and nylon
 nut (3324) from the driving rod (3352).

Replace the valve seal (3318)
 together with the cylindrical
 valve (3322).

It is recommended replace the control valve assembly of the
 pneumatic operating mechanism every 5,000 times of operation.

The circuit breaker should be out of service before commencing
 this work.

Replacement procedure is as
 follows

items: Close the circuit breaker.
Switch off the control circuit.

Exhaust the compressed air in the air reservoir (3090)from the drain valve
 .
Insert the tripping preventing pin (3360) (refer to Fig .8 (A)).
Remove the wiring of the trip coil assembly (3380).
Remove the pin (3132) (refer to Fig. 9(a))
Remove the air piping (3353). (refer to Fig . 9 (a)).
Remove the bolts A (3398) and bolts B(3399) .
Take out the control valve assembly (3300)
Remove the bolts D (3396) and the trip coil assembly (3380).
Replace the control valve assembly (3300)
